The language id is the registry key: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. The grammar library must export tree_sitter_<language name>. Extensions are separated by spaces or commas and written without the dot; extensions handled by a built-in language cannot be taken over.
Import

Import only grammars you trust: a grammar library is native code and runs inside this app. Files are copied into app-private storage, never into your project. A grammar library cannot be unloaded once used, so it stays in memory until the app is restarted.

Supported: one lib*.so grammar library plus one *.scm highlight query, up to 32 MiB each, at most 32 imported grammars and 20 extensions per language. The highlight query is read up to 1 MiB. The grammar ABI must be in the range supported by the bundled runtime; outside it, highlighting falls back to the lexer.
